visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen layout. On the left, a man in a green shirt and surgical mask stands in a brightly lit bakery (Le Mout) at an airport, gesturing toward glass display cases filled with pastries. On the right, the same man is shown inside an airplane cabin, biting into a croissant with a look of pure satisfaction. The lighting in the bakery is warm and professional, while the plane interior is bright with natural light from a window. (2) A brief shot of an airplane wing over a vast sea of white clouds against a deep blue sky provides a geographical transition. The camera then cuts back to the bakery, showing the man walking through the terminal, carrying a brown paper bag and a bottle of water, looking back at the camera as he navigates the crowd. (3) The camera focuses on the bakery's interior, showcasing various packaged breads, croissants, and baguettes on wooden trays behind glass. Price tags are visible on the trays. The man, still in his green shirt, points at specific items while holding his phone and wallet. (4) Inside the airplane, a close-up shows the man taking a large bite of a black truffle butter roll. He closes his eyes and smiles, emphasizing the texture and flavor. The background reveals other passengers and the compact environment of a commercial flight. (5) A menu card titled "特別推薦" (Special Recommendations) is displayed, listing various pastries like Almond Croissants and Truffle Butter Rolls with their prices. The man's hands are visible as he handles the pastry inside a clear plastic bag on the airplane tray table. (6) The man is seen again on the plane eating a "French Butter Pastry." He breaks it apart to show the flaky, layered interior to the camera before eating it. His facial expressions are exaggerated to show delight, nodding and smiling widely. (7) The final sequence returns to the bakery storefront. The man stands in front of the "LE MOUT" logo, pointing towards the store. Background travelers are blurred, keeping the focus on the creator and the retail space. Graphical overlays with location details appear as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with an enthusiastic male voice providing energetic narration in Traditional Chinese. The background music is an upbeat, bright electronic-pop track with a consistent 124 BPM 4/4 rhythm. The vocals are clear and prominent, exhibiting high pitch variability and a friendly, persuasive tone. (2) At approximately 0:27, a sharp and crisp 'Food Bite / Crunch' sound effect occurs as the speaker is seen eating on screen. This transient SFX marks a phase transition. The BGM continues smoothly, while the speaker's tone remains high-arousal and positive. (3) A subtle 'Plastic / Bag Rustle' is heard around 0:40 as the creator handles the pastry packaging. The acoustic environment shifts slightly from studio-clean narration to the muffled room tone of an airplane cabin, though the narration remains the primary signal. (4) Another 'crunch' SFX is heard at 0:43, coinciding with the man biting the French butter pastry. The BGM remains steady with no major structural pauses. The speaker's voice quality exhibits clarity and high enunciation. (5) The final phase features a gentle 'Whoosh' transition SFX as a graphic appears. The narrator delivers a concluding CTA with a rising intonation pattern. The music begins a brief fade-out as the video ends, maintaining its cheerful, major-mode tonality throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Location Intro -> Product Showcase -> Tasting Experience -> Recommendation/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'Le Mout Bakery' located in Terminal 2 of Taoyuan International Airport. By showcasing the creator's personal experience of buying and enjoying their pastries on a plane, it positions the bakery as a 'must-visit' spot for travelers looking for high-quality food options before their flight.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the store, shows the location, displays a menu with prices, and provides a direct recommendation for viewers to save the video for their next trip.
